category: Purpose-built AI governance (documentation x use-case/regulation-centric); mentioned in Gartner MQ 2026
central_object: AI use case (explicitly argued as the right unit, over model or vendor), with models, agents, vendors linked
positioning: 'The AI governance platform for regulated enterprises' - intake, risk & impact, monitoring and compliance in one system of record; risk-based triage so low-risk AI is auto-approved.
buyer: AI governance lead, General Counsel/legal, compliance in regulated mid-to-large enterprises and public sector (Leidos, Nuix, Mariner Finance)
key_modules: Intake & triage (risk-based routing: Low auto-approval, Medium standard review, High deep review, with SLAs)
Unified AI inventory (use cases, models, agents, vendors)
Risk & impact assessments with expert-curated risk cards
Monitor (post-deployment incidents, user feedback)
Comply (EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF coverage %)
Executive dashboard; AI assistant ('Ask me anything about your AI inventory')
nav_structure: Dashboard tabs Executive · Workflows · Task Management; 'On this page' jump nav (Key metrics, Recent use cases, Use case overview, Risk overview, Workflow progress, Framework readiness); Dashboard Filters and Share controls.

Dark-header sortable table: use case, status pill, ROI, inherent vs residual risk level, benefit, #risks, #mitigations
Risk-routing lanes with SLA countdowns ('1 day left')
Framework readiness as % bars
'On this page' anchor list for long dashboards
Shareable dashboard link for executives

Use case is a design-time object, not a per-action record
No verifiable artefacts
